height.$description: Default height of a Chart (200px). The height prop overrides it per instance.

stroke-w.$description: Stroke width of the line series and of point rings (1.5px, same as icons).

point-r.$description: Radius of the active point marker of a line Chart (3.5px).

grid-dash.$description: Dash length of the grid lines of a Chart (2px).

grid-gap.$description: Gap between dashes of the grid lines of a Chart (3px).

area-opacity.$description: Opacity of the area under the line of a line Chart (0.08).

outline-w.$description: Outline width of a highlighted bar (2px). Together with the label it is the non-color cue of a highlight.

tooltip-padding-inline.$description: Horizontal padding of the value label of the active Chart point (8px).

tooltip-padding-block.$description: Vertical padding of the value label of the active Chart point (4px).

ref-w.$description: Stroke width of a reference line (average or target) in a Chart (1px).

ref-average-dash.$description: Dash length of an average reference line (6px). Long dashes tell it apart from the target line without color.

ref-average-gap.$description: Gap between dashes of an average reference line (4px).

ref-target-dash.$description: Dash length of a target reference line (10px). Dash, gap, dot, gap: tells it apart from the average line without color.

ref-target-dot.$description: Dot length of a target reference line (2px), between its dashes.

ref-target-gap.$description: Gap around the dot and between dashes of a target reference line (3px).

tooltip-max-w.$description: Widest the active-point label grows before a long note wraps (240px). Keep in sync with chartLayout.ts.

color.$description: Series color of a Chart. Each tone class sets it; it can be overridden at runtime via style (ADR-0002 amendment).

tooltip-x.$description: Horizontal position of the active-point label, in px from the chart's left edge. Set at runtime via style.

tooltip-y.$description: Vertical position of the active-point label, in px from the chart's top edge. Set at runtime via style.
